items.data_available: A sample dataset of annotated multilingual documents across 5 languages and 4 document types will be provided.

items.expected_outcome: A working pipeline that ingests raw documents and outputs structured, validated data with confidence scores.
items.requirements: Submit code, documentation, a demo video and a presentation. Include evaluation metrics on the provided dataset.

items.data_available: A dataset of customer accounts, usage patterns and churn labels.

items.data_available: A labeled network traffic dataset with multiple attack classes and severe class imbalance.
items.description: Develop a network intrusion detection model that handles highly imbalanced threat data and adapts to evolving attack patterns.
